description: The partial output of a machine is obtained by searching for its least numerical output certificate and applying the fixed first-projection extractor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute_search
  (M : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Machine) (x : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute M x =
    Part.map Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.firstCertificate M x)
